title: Theming
summary: What a theme is. Modifiers such as light and dark are data, not generated colors.

questions.summary: A theme can be one token set, or token sets plus modifiers.

options.label: Token sets plus modifiers
options.why: A theme is a set of token sets plus modifiers, such as light and dark.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if light and dark are modifiers on one theme.
trade_offs: You maintain more than one set

recommends.question: default-theme
recommends.reason: Token sets plus modifiers need a default set so one theme is in effect before a switch.

options.label: Single token set
options.why: One token set is the whole theme, with no light or dark modifier.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if you ship a single appearance.
trade_offs: Dark mode later means a new theme

questions.why_care: It decides whether light and dark are modifiers on one theme, or whether you ship one look.

questions.prompt: Which token set is in effect before a modifier?
questions.summary: One set is the default. The other is a modifier.
questions.why_care: It decides whether light or dark is the set people see before they switch.

options.label: Light
options.summary: Light is the default token set.
options.why: Light is the set in effect before someone switches to dark.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if the page should open on the light set.

options.label: Dark
options.summary: Dark is the default token set.
options.why: Dark is the set in effect before someone switches to light.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if the page should open on the dark set.
